import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
libgslcblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
libgsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the cblas_cher2 function argument and return types
libgslcblas.cblas_cher2.argtypes = [
    ctypes.c_int,  # order
    ctypes.c_int,  # uplo
    ctypes.c_int,  # N
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),  # alpha (pointer to complex float)
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),  # X (pointer to complex float array)
    ctypes.c_int,  # incX
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),  # Y (pointer to complex float array)
    ctypes.c_int,  # incY
    ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float),  # A (pointer to complex float array)
    ctypes.c_int   # lda
]
libgslcblas.cblas_cher2.restype = None

# Define constants for CBLAS_ORDER and CBLAS_UPLO
CblasRowMajor = 101
CblasColMajor = 102
CblasUpper = 121
CblasLower = 122


def cblas_cher2(order, uplo, N, alpha, X, incX, Y, incY, A, lda):
    # Convert inputs to ctypes-compatible types
    alpha_c = (ctypes.c_float * 2)(alpha.real, alpha.imag)
    X_c = X.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float))
    Y_c = Y.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float))
    A_c = A.ctypes.data_as(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_float))

    # Call the cblas_cher2 function
    libgslcblas.cblas_cher2(
        order, uplo, N, alpha_c, X_c, incX, Y_c, incY, A_c, lda
    )


def assert_test():
    # Define input parameters
    N = 2
    alpha = 1 + 0j  # Scalar alpha
    X = np.array([1+1j, 2+2j], dtype=np.complex64)  # Complex vector X
    Y = np.array([3+3j, 4+4j], dtype=np.complex64)  # Complex vector Y
    A = np.array([
        [1+0j, 0+0j],
        [0+0j, 1+0j]
    ], dtype=np.complex64)  # Hermitian matrix A

    # Convert A to a flattened array for column-major order
    A_flat = A.flatten()

    # Call the cblas_cher2 function
    cblas_cher2(CblasColMajor, CblasLower, N, alpha, X, 1, Y, 1, A_flat, N)

    # Reshape the result back to a 2D matrix
    A_updated = A_flat.reshape((N, N))

    # Ensure Hermitian property by mirroring the lower triangle to the upper triangle
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            A_updated[j, i] = np.conj(A_updated[i, j])

    # Expected result (manually computed)
    expected_A = np.array([
        [13+0j, 20+0j],
        [20+0j, 33+0j]
    ], dtype=np.complex64)

    # Assert that the updated matrix matches the expected result
    assert np.allclose(A_updated, expected_A, atol=1e-5), f"Test failed: {A_updated} != {expected_A}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
